args.title: Juniper Labware: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Juniper Labware newsletter, its linked article, and the article's companion piece:

• Newsletter: This week's Juniper Labware newsletter features "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to a blog article (with a mirror link offered in case charts don't load).
• Article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
